protocol.normalization: Norman log2(1+1e6*pooled UMI/pooled library UMI), subtract control; Schmidt source LFC unchanged
protocol.norman_readout_selection: largest variance across disclosed single perturbation deltas; Ensembl ID tie break
protocol.primary: hypothesis minus summary on fixed random histories, final probe MSE; each screen separately
protocol.repair: one schema-only retry; then observed-data-only fallback; failures included
protocol.ridge: Gaussian linear posterior mean, unit observation variance and prior precision 2; additive prior for Norman, zero for Schmidt
protocol.source_warning: Public historical outcomes may occur in LLM training data; no contamination-free claim.
protocol.uncertainty: split mean, SD and full range; overlapping splits are not biological replicates
